race.comment: VOUCHERS (7) is the one to beat after winning a BM55 at this track two starts ago, then running second to Khamis at Townsville after copping interference approaching the 500m. This is a stronger BM60, but he drops from 60kg to 57.5kg, Ryan Wiggins goes back on, and his record of two wins and one place from three starts at this track and distance means he is a big threat. MANHATTAN'S (5) brings the fresh winning form, having beaten Okay Zoomer at Townsville last week after being steadied in the run, and her previous Class 4 second at this venue reads well for this. The wide barrier is the obvious query but she can measure up. SUPERSTITIONS (1) has been close up in two 1200m runs, including an Open third at Innisfail, and his record at this track keeps him in the mix. KEEP SAFE (4) is third-up, drops back from a Class 5 at Townsville, and has Lacey Morrison booked. Keep safe.
